bio: Calgary Board of Education: Biology 20/30 course topics
sci: Calgary Board of Education: Science 10/20/30 course topics
inquiry: Alberta Science 10 program (government-hosted copy): inquiry skills, pp. 8–10

botaneco: Compare separated fractions and test their properties; proteins and oleosomes are application context, not required terminology.
nanalysis: Fields and electromagnetic radiation: an NMR extension
Apply fields and electromagnetic-radiation ideas to measurement. Nuclear spin and Fourier transforms are extension material, not required high-school outcomes.
exergy-solutions: Compare the load a bracket must carry with the material and geometry used; printing is an engineering context rather than a required manufacturing topic.
livestock-water-recycling: Compare what remains in different output streams. Clearer water is not automatically safe drinking water.
avmax: Forces and evidence from mechanical tests
Use forces and measured deformation to discuss inspection evidence. Students are evaluating evidence, not making airworthiness decisions.
northern-rna: Connect nucleic acids to biological production, then compare batch evidence. Industrial quality systems are an application, not a required molecular-biology outcome.
aerium-analytics: Compare bird observations before and after intervention, with season and weather as competing explanations. A behavioural response alone does not prove population change.
geologicai: Combine geological observations with sensor evidence. X-ray and hyperspectral methods extend electromagnetic-radiation ideas; a scan does not establish an entire deposit.
tangent-design-engineering: Track material inputs and outputs as throughput grows; engineering layout and controls extend the chemistry rather than replacing quantitative relationships.
foremost: Forces and contact with the ground
Start with weight and support forces, then extend to pressure as force divided by area. Soft-soil behaviour and tracked-vehicle design go beyond the course model.
carbonova: Track carbon atoms into new materials and identify missing inputs and outputs. A carbon-containing product alone does not prove a net climate benefit.
summit-lithium-technologies: Compare capture, release and repeated-cycle measurements. Selective sorbents are an application; the proprietary chemistry is not claimed to be known.
veerum: Scientific inquiry: measurement and model checking
A cross-unit inquiry-skills connection: compare a model with observations, identify gaps and judge whether data are fit for a decision. No specific physics unit or digital-twin outcome is claimed.
eguana-technologies: Distinguish stored energy from the rate of transfer. Capacity divided by load is an idealized runtime; actual losses and operating limits change it.
ftg-aerospace-calgary: Separate atmospheric measurements, transmission and interpretation. Aircraft observations sample particular routes and times; they do not provide complete atmospheric coverage.
